```{r}
require(dplyr)
require(tidyverse)
library(here)

```

## Read in Mouse and Other Mammals data sets

```{r}
# Mouse
mouse_metadata <- readRDS(here("output_data/mouse_data/bulk/simplified_mouse_metadata_9-19-26.rds"))
  
mouse_expr <- readRDS(here("output_data/mouse_data/bulk/mouse_exp_tmm_logcpm.rds"))

# Non-mouse
mammals_expr <- readRDS(here("output_data/non_mouse_data/updated_data/species_exp_tmm_logcpm.rds"))

mammals_metadata_orig <- readRDS(here("output_data/non_mouse_data/updated_data/species_metadata_harmonized_9-30-26.rds"))

# Rename some of the columns
mammals_metadata <- mammals_metadata_orig %>%
  rename_with(~c("Sample", "BioProject", "Species", "CancerType", "CancerTypeFinal", "Tissue", "CancerSystem"),
              .cols = c("run_accession", "bioproject", "organism_scientific_name", "paipu_cancer_type", "paipu_cancer_type_final", "paipu_tissue_final", "paipu_cancer_system")) 

# Only keep certain columns in the metadata
mammals_metadata <- mammals_metadata %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, BioProject, Species, CancerType, CancerTypeFinal, Tissue, CancerSystem)
```

```{r}
# Make Genes rownames
mammals_expr <- mammals_expr %>%
  column_to_rownames("Genes") %>%
  as.matrix()

mouse_expr <- mouse_expr %>%
  column_to_rownames("Genes") %>%
  as.matrix()
```

```{r}
# Check if they're in the same order
all(colnames(mammals_expr) == mammals_metadata$Sample)
all(colnames(mouse_expr) == mouse_metadata$Sample)

```

```{r}
# Any all 0 samples?
print("Number of all zero samples: ")
print(paste0("Other Mammals: ", sum(colSums(mammals_expr) == 0)))
print(paste0("Mouse: ", sum(colSums(mouse_expr) == 0)))
```

## Combine the mammals + mouse exp data
```{r}
# Get common genes in mouse and other mammals normalized data
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(mammals_expr), rownames(mouse_expr))

nrow(mammals_expr)
nrow(mouse_expr)
length(common_genes)
```

```{r}
# Only keep the common genes
mammals_expr_common  <- mammals_expr[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
mouse_expr_common <- mouse_expr[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# Combine expr data
combined_expr <- cbind(mammals_expr_common, mouse_expr_common)

```


## Combine mouse + mammals metadata

```{r}
combined_metadata <- bind_rows(mammals_metadata, mouse_metadata)
```

```{r}
# Reorder metadata to match the expr data
combined_metadata <- combined_metadata[
  match(colnames(combined_expr), combined_metadata$Sample),
]

# Check
all(colnames(combined_expr) == combined_metadata$Sample)

```

```{r}
# Check
print("Combined metadata and expr data dimensions: ")
dim(combined_metadata)
dim(combined_expr)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

plot_folder <- "plots/species+mouse_data"

visualize_pca <- function(exp, met, title, sp_colors){
  # set Genes as row names
  all_exp_filtered_rem <- exp %>% column_to_rownames("Genes")
  
  # transpose the data to make the genes in columns and samples in rows
  exp_transposed <- t(all_exp_filtered_rem)
  
  # remove 0 values to plot PCA
  exp_subset <- exp_transposed[, which(apply(exp_transposed, 2, var) != 0), drop = FALSE]
  
  # perform PCA
  df_pca <- prcomp(exp_subset, scale = TRUE, center = TRUE)
  
  # Calculate percent variance explained by each PC (weights)
  pve <- (df_pca$sdev^2) / sum(df_pca$sdev^2) * 100
  
  # Print PC weights
  cat("PC1:", round(pve[1], 2), "%\n")
  cat("PC2:", round(pve[2], 2), "%\n")
  
  print(data.frame(
    PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(pve)),
    VarianceExplained = round(pve, 2)
  ))
  
  # add species metadata
  df <- data.frame(
    PC1 = df_pca$x[,1],
    PC2 = df_pca$x[,2],
    Species = met$Species
  )
  
  # count samples in each PCA group
  species_counts <- table(df$Species)
  
  # plot pca w/ mouse smaller and lower alpha
  pca_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Species)) +
    
    # plot mouse first in the background
    geom_point(data = df %>% filter(Species == "Mus musculus"),
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    # plot other mammals on top of mouse
    geom_point(
      data = df %>% filter(Species != "Mus musculus"),
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
    #scale_color_manual(values = sp_colors) +
    # add commas when necessary for species count labels
    scale_color_manual(values = sp_colors, labels = function(x) {
      paste0(x, " (", format(species_counts[x], big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE), ")")
    }) +
    theme_minimal() + # white background
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), # bold axis lines
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
  
  # save pca plot
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(title, ".pdf"),
    plot = pca_plot,
    path = here(plot_folder),
    width = 10, height = 8,
    #limitsize = FALSE,
    device = cairo_pdf
  )
  
  return(pca_plot)
}
```

## Output simplified, full and final metadata and exp data 
```{r}
# Read in mouse full bulk metadata and filter only to samples in the exp data
mouse_full_met <- readRDS(here("output_data/mouse_data/bulk/mouse_metadata_harmonized_9-30-26.rds"))

# Check if full and simplified metadata have the same samples and in the same order
all(mouse_full_met$run_accession == mouse_metadata$Sample)

```

```{r}
# List of mouse cols to convert to char type to match mammals metadata
cols_to_char <- c("organism_tax_id", "run_total_spots", "run_total_bases", "run_size", "run_has_tax_analysis", "a_count", "c_count", "g_count", "t_count", "n_count", "rin", "pool", "duplicate_sample", "litter")

# Make mouse cols char type
mouse_full_met <- mouse_full_met %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cols_to_char), as.character))

# Combine mammals_metadata_orig and mouse full metadata
combined_full_met <- bind_rows(mammals_metadata_orig, mouse_full_met)

# Make sure the full metadata matches combined_expr ordering
all(colnames(combined_expr) == combined_full_met$run_accession)
```

```{r}
# Output full combined metadata
saveRDS(combined_full_met, file = here("output_data/mouse_data/bulk/species+mouse_metadata_harmonized_9-30-26.rds"))

write_tsv(combined_full_met, file = here("output_data/mouse_data/bulk/species+mouse_metadata_harmonized_9-30-26.tsv"))

# Output simplified combined metadata
saveRDS(combined_metadata, file = here("output_data/mouse_data/bulk/simplified_species+mouse_metadata_9-30-26.rds"))

write_tsv(combined_metadata, file = here("output_data/mouse_data/bulk/simplified_species+mouse_metadata_9-30-26.tsv"))

```

## Visualize PCA - colored by cancer system

```{r}
library(Polychrome)
data("glasbey")

# Function to view pca colored by CancerSystem
visualize_pca_cs <- function(exp, met, title, color_by = "CancerSystem", custom_colors = NULL){
  # Set Genes as row names
  all_exp_filtered_rem <- exp %>% column_to_rownames("Genes")
  
  # Transpose the data (genes in columns, samples in rows)
  exp_transposed <- t(all_exp_filtered_rem)
  
  # Remove 0 variance genes
  exp_subset <- exp_transposed[, which(apply(exp_transposed, 2, var) != 0), drop = FALSE]
  
  # Perform PCA
  df_pca <- prcomp(exp_subset, scale = TRUE, center = TRUE)
  
  # Prepare PCA dataframe
  df <- data.frame(
    PC1 = df_pca$x[,1],
    PC2 = df_pca$x[,2],
    ColorGroup = met[[color_by]],
    Species = if ("Species" %in% colnames(met)) met$Species else NA
  )
  
  # count samples in each cancer system
  group_counts <- table(df$ColorGroup)
  
  # If no custom colors, use viridis
  if (is.null(custom_colors)) {
    groups <- unique(df$ColorGroup)
    n_colors <- length(groups)
    custom_colors <- glasbey[1:n_colors]
    names(custom_colors) <- groups
  }
  
  # Base ggplot setup
  pca_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
    labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", color = "Cancer System") +
    theme_minimal() + # white background
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), # bold axis lines
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
  
  # Plot mouse first in the background
  pca_plot <- pca_plot +
    geom_point(data = df %>% filter(Species == "Mus musculus"),
      aes(color = ColorGroup),
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    # Plot other mammals on top
    geom_point(
      data = df %>% filter(Species != "Mus musculus"),
      aes(color = ColorGroup),
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.8
    )
  
  # Apply color scale and sample counts to legend
  pca_plot <- pca_plot + #scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors)
    scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors, labels = function(x) {
      paste0(x, " (", format(group_counts[x], big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE), ")")
    })
  
  # Save PCA plot as pdf
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(title, ".pdf"),
    plot = pca_plot,
    path = here(plot_folder),
    width = 10, height = 8,
    #limitsize = FALSE,
    device = cairo_pdf
  )
  
  return(pca_plot)
}

```

## Output PCAs as a figure in a 1x1 grid 

```{r}
library(patchwork)
```


```{r}
# Create grid with PCA after normalization no duplicates colored by species and colored by cancer system
pca_fig_sp <- (combined_pca + combined_cs_pca) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 22), # panel labels size
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16), # legend font size
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16), # legend title size
        legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "cm")) & # legend symbols size
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)) # legend point size
  )

pca_fig_sp
```

```{r}
# Save figure as pdf
ggsave(here(plot_folder, "AtlasPCA.pdf"), pca_fig_sp, width = 20, height = 10, device = cairo_pdf)

```
